contentJudgment: The revised condensation preserves Storr’s linked investigation of the social self and the culture’s ideal, including the historical route and the final turn toward bounded personality and environment. It is coherent at each depth and retains actual people, experiments and reporting rather than replacing the book with reader exercises. Crucial qualifications survive: multiple suicide pathways, correlation versus causal intervention, self-worth versus narcissistic superiority, the disputed generation trend, economic benefits as well as costs, CJ as an extreme case, possible change without unlimited reinvention, and responsibility toward others. No required meaning correction found.

optionalSuggestions.en: The book treats them as adjustable levels rather than switches: everyone has a different combination.
optionalSuggestions.suggestion: “Levels on dials rather than on/off switches” would carry the metaphor without the slight suggestion of voluntary adjustability in “adjustable levels”. Adjacent screens already state personality stability and limits on change, so the present route is not materially misleading.
optionalSuggestions.sourceLocator: OPS/ch1-20.xhtml, paragraph 49: qualities are present to greater or lesser degrees; the surrounding argument concerns stable differences, not freely chosen settings.

materialLimitations: Primary reading was targeted across all eight numbered books, with the actual closing argument/rocket scene and methodology read in the specified continuous passages. Longer narratives and much interior exposition were not read continuously. No full-book reading claim.
No full English edition consulted. EN was read as a translation of the condensation and checked against the supplied Russian primary meaning.
This verifies the condensation’s representation of Storr, not the entire historical causal chain, primary clinical records, all underlying social psychology or a comprehensive current science update.
The source note honestly frames the historical chain as Storr’s account and describes selective reading; these limits do not leave a particular essential passage unsupported.
Root/catalogue/publication, browser/device behavior and saved-progress integration are outside this content review.
